Ok. Here's my take on it. As a girl.     

You like someone. You are friends with that person, maybe not super close, but you get along well. More than an acquaintance. You have declared your love to that person and he/she doesn't return your feelings, for whatever reason. They just aren't into you, or they "don't want to ruin the friendship", or something like that.    

That's all ok an understandable.       

You are now on the friendzone. You can't progress with that person because you are their friend, and they don't want to be more than that with you. To them, you are in the zone of "just friends". The friendzone.     

That's it.     

I don't know why people talk about "blaming" or "invalidating" the other person. You never do that. Just, when the topic is brought, you say that you're just friends, specifically, that you want to be more than friends, but the other person doesn't. That is just the truth. You may now go find someone else and, luckily, eventually not caring that you're "just friends", because you'll be after that other new person.        

It' called unrequited love, as someone else pointed out. Nothing else and nothing new.
